method: Actual Chrome extension CUA screenshots and browser link interactions; read-only DOM geometry and link checks; local byte hashing of clicked downloads and immutable approved files. No external browser-control libraries.
issues_and_limits: All five article full-page desktop and 390px images were visually inspected. Six PDF files rendered actual first pages; visible PDF toolbar page counts were 33+7,5,7,5,5. This is a display test, not a new line-by-line mathematical review of all PDF pages.

Initial lazy embedded viewers on brace and Nijenhuis stayed blank through two captures. Their original states are preserved. Fresh ephemeral-tab normal top-to-Read-on-this-page tests displayed actual PDFs on the first post-click capture without reload. The original cause is not established. These tests used the existing browser profile/cache, not a controlled cold-cache profile.
A few Chrome navigation commands detached after completing navigation; tab inventory and fresh state recovered the same temporary tab. No native-app control was used.

The six local ZIP archive download links were actually clicked and downloaded bytes hashed. The remote 94MB JC companion archive was not redundantly downloaded through the browser; its exact visible URL and previously acquired original/receipt were rehashed and bound.
Prior-work links and contact links were inspected as DOM targets; no outreach, form submission or blanket external-link test was performed.
The user Sheet was never claimed or changed. No site/source/CSS/Git/deployment/redirect mutation was made during display review.
